summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity, which links a document to a Site by ID. No business logic; only fields.
purpose: To associate documents with a specific Site via IDs for organization or retrieval.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the related Site

content_gaps: No workflows, business rules, conditions, or actors defined.

summary: Implements the Welcome Staff Admin UI, showing last login, error/warning panels, site and discipline filter dropdowns, date controls, and a grid of submitted employment applications.
purpose: To provide a dashboard for staff administrators, enabling filtering and viewing of submitted employment applications.

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: StaffAdmin logs in and sees dashboard.
Filters by site, discipline, start/end date, show withdrawn.
Views applications in grid.
Clicks refresh to update view.
Can view applicant detail by clicking name link.

business_rules: StartDate must be before EndDate (validated by 'checkStartEnd').
Required fields for StartDate and EndDate.
Filtering by site and discipline updates grid.
conditions: ShowWithdrawn: If checked, withdrawn applications are included.
system_behavior: Grid allows paging and dynamic data binding.
Javascript variables set for date controls.
Panels for error/warning shown as needed.
content_gaps: No explicit exception handling logic found.

summary: Defines ServiceCode data model and retrieval logic, including support for alternate language fields and filtering by CourseID or TimetableID.
purpose: To manage and retrieve service code definitions with support for alternate languages and context-specific filtering.

workflows.name: Retrieve ServiceCodes
steps: ServiceCodeListAll: retrieves all service codes.
ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID: retrieves service codes for a specific course.
ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID: retrieves service codes for a specific timetable.
Localize: sets alternate language text if session is in alt language mode.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name and Notes use alternate values.
system_behavior: Data retrieval via stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
content_gaps: No business rules for validation, only data retrieval and localization.

summary: Defines SiteProfileHistory entity and its search/fill workflows for tracking site profile changes, including user actions and alt language support.
purpose: To record and retrieve history of changes made to Site Profiles, including who performed the action, when, and what changed.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistorySearch
steps: Invoke stored procedure SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Fill entity data from result, including alt-language if session settings require.
Return list of SiteProfileHistory records.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields: use alt-language fields for ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields.
AgencyUserFormatted combines agency and abbreviated user name.
conditions: If ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID and not sys admin, prepend support team info.
system_behavior: User control for rendering history grid; respects session context.
Displays tooltip with user details and phone.
dependencies: Session context for alt language and user info

summary: Defines EmailPopupDocument entity and logic for listing and deleting popup email documents, with support for batch deletion and folder cleanup.
purpose: Supports management (listing/deleting) of popup email documents used for notifications.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: User or System invokes Delete with DataInfo and ID.
Deletes file at FilePath.
Attempts to delete containing folder.
Returns updated DataInfo string minus deleted entry.

workflows.name: List Email Popup Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo.
Split entries, create EmailPopupDocument instances.
Return the list.

business_rules: If emailData length is 2, create EmailPopupDocument entry.
system_behavior: Deletes file and folder if possible; silent catch on exceptions.
Parses pipe-separated DataInfo for batch operations.
content_gaps: No rules for validation or permissions.

purpose: Provides a reporting structure for placements linked to cost centre details and metrics over time.

workflows.name: Retrieve CostCentre Records
steps: Invoke PlacementCostCentre stored procedure with filters.
Fill CostCentreRecord entities from result.
Return list for reporting.

system_behavior: Data retrieval via stored procedure PlacementCostCentre.
